name: Alleppey Backwaters
summary: Serene network of brackish lagoons, lakes, and canals known for houseboat cruises.
description: Alleppey (Alappuzha) is famous for its serene backwaters, palm-fringed canals, and traditional houseboat stays in southern India.
history: Known as the Venice of the East, a historic maritime trading port for coir, black pepper, and spices.
culture: Celebrated for the annual Nehru Trophy Boat Race and authentic Keralite backwater lifestyle.

tips: Book government-certified houseboats (DTPC) for guaranteed quality.
